# A DOCTORED copy of coil-run.txt, for criterion 6's ghost race.
#
# Made by probes/coil-course/results/make_slow_variant.py: stall 1 at 835.
# Nothing else differs from the original.
#
# It exists because a session that plays coil-run.txt against a personal
# best set by coil-run.txt races a ghost of itself and the split is zero.
# Zero is a true number and weak evidence — it is also what a comparison
# that was not happening at all would print. This run finishes in
# 5112 ms against the original's 5096 ms, so the split is
# +16 ms: visibly non-zero, and the right sign.
#
# The perturbation was not chosen by taste. The script sweeps candidates
# and replays every one, because these commands are absolute view angles
# timed for a moving player: most changes end the run in a wall rather
# than merely slowing it down.
